# grace

> Your daily GLP-1 companion — personalized SMS support for people on GLP-1 medications like Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, and Zepbound.

grace sends personalized daily text messages — hydration reminders, meal ideas, injection-day guidance, and encouragement — tailored to your specific GLP-1 medication. No app download needed. Just texts.

## What grace Does

- Morning check-ins with hydration and protein goals
- Midday meal suggestions based on food preferences
- Injection-day reminders and side-effect follow-ups
- Evening wind-down messages
- Weekly milestone celebrations and weight tracking

## Who It's For

grace is designed for people taking GLP-1 receptor agonist medications (semaglutide, tirzepatide) who want daily support and structure during their weight-loss journey. Most users are women aged 40–70 who prefer simple, text-based communication over complex apps.

## How It Works

1. Complete a 2-minute onboarding quiz (medication, goals, schedule, food preferences)
2. Receive personalized daily texts starting the next morning
3. Reply to texts naturally — grace adapts based on your responses
4. Try free for 7 days; cancel anytime by texting STOP

## Supported Medications

- Ozempic (semaglutide)
- Wegovy (semaglutide)
- Mounjaro (tirzepatide)
- Zepbound (tirzepatide)

## Key Features

- No app required — works via SMS
- Personalized to your medication, goals, and preferences
- Adapts daily based on your replies and mood
- Injection-day tracking with side-effect monitoring
- Meal ideas that respect your food preferences and dislikes

## Pricing

- 7-day free trial
- SMS-based subscription after trial
